verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents built-in AI extraction (ai_query, ai_extract_rules), but nothing in the evidence shows a way to configure a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend; the AI features run on ScrapingBee's own service. Returning markdown so a user can feed it to their own model is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend instead of a cloud-only model
